evidencePolicy.verified: Raw KDEN observations retrieved from Iowa Environmental Mesonet on 2026-10-05; archive quality limits apply. These are not Apple WeatherKit responses.
evidencePolicy.assumption: All normalization, condition analogues, accumulation models, reference initial states and rendering outcomes are proposal choices. Solar values are calculations.
evidencePolicy.unknown: No measured neighborhood wetness or snow-covered fraction is available. Null means unknown, never zero.

location.name: Denver International Airport public observation station
location.scope: Denver-area weather fixtures, not observations at Sloan’s Lake or a home

normalization.wind: knots * 0.514444444444; direction FROM true north, clockwise; null for variable direction
normalization.visibility: statute miles * 1609.344; 10SM is reporting-limited and treated as at least this distance, not exact clear-air visibility
normalization.cloudCover: max reported category: CLR/SKC=0, FEW=.1875, SCT=.4375, BKN=.75, OVC/VV=1. Category conversion is an assumption; CLR does not exclude all high clouds.
normalization.precipitation: p01i *25.4 is liquid-equivalent mm over prior hour for selected routine reports, not instantaneous intensity. T preserved in raw; reference midpoint .127 mm assumes conservative trace interval [0,.254]. No sum of overlapping special reports.
normalization.phase: SN without RA => snow; RA without SN => rain; combined or positive precip with absent code and T<=2 => 1-smoothstep(-1,2,T); otherwise rain. This phase reconstruction is an assumption.
normalization.historyTiming: Each selected report supplies the preceding one-hour model interval; temperature/wind/cloud/humidity held constant at report values. Solar sampled 30 minutes before interval end.
normalization.missing: M wxcodes means no reported present-weather code here, not proof of zero hourly precipitation; M numeric fields remain missing. Missing numerical inputs must yield unknown state.
normalization.moon: No moon data supplied by these observations. Fixtures do not claim lunar phase or night-light validation.

solarReference.method: NOAA/Meeus equations matching current WorldGeo solar model, geometric elevation without refraction
